candidates.label: unexplained
candidates.explanation: No Gaia DR3 source follows this track.

notes: Tracks are kept when their motion is at least 5 times its own uncertainty.

Over this 1.00 year baseline the search finds objects moving faster than roughly 6.0″ per year when bright, and about twice that when faint. Slower objects are invisible until SPHEREx has observed for longer.
A distant Solar System body would not appear here: the Earth's own orbit moves it hundreds of arcseconds between passes, far outside this field. What this finds is nearby stars and brown dwarfs.
